suggestions.title: Fix flaky animal_sound quiz test (game.service.ts)
suggestions.description: The for-loop in generateAnimalQuiz() with 'continue' on duplicate names could produce fewer than 3 questions when difficulty=1. Changed to while loop with targetCount = Math.min(3+difficulty, animals.length) to guarantee minimum questions.
